title: Research evaluation of the project "Helping in mental distress"
summary:
The project, funded by the Bavarian State Ministry of Health, Care, and Prevention,
focuses on first-aid courses for mental health emergencies and crisis situations. To this end, training sessions will be conducted in a blended-learning format for various age groups within the population. In addition, training sessions for future course instructors will also be offered in the same format. The training sessions are continuously evaluated scientifically by administering specific questionnaires at various time points before and after the course.

interventions.name: Intervention group: Participants who are surveyed using a questionnaire on willingness to help, confidence to help, mental health literacy , stigma, and their own mental health conditions immediately before (t0), immediately after (t1, i.e., 2 hours after t0), and six months after (t2) participating

Control group (no intervention): Participants who are surveyed at time point t0, two hours later (t1), and six months later (t2) using a questionnaire on willingness to help, safety of helping, mental health literacy, stigma, and their own psychological distress

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Participants in the psychological first aid courses “Helping in Mental Distress” (HSN) for the intervention group; mental stability as determined by the course instructors; no other criteria
Exclusion criteria:
mental stability as determined by the course instructors
